explanation: For business meetings in Turkey, visitors are expected to arrive on time even though their Turkish counterparts may themselves run a little late — arriving late as a guest can still read as a lack of respect. Social gatherings are far more flexible about timing.
local_tip: Plan to arrive on time or a few minutes early for business meetings, and message ahead if you'll be delayed.
regional_note: Expectations are strictest in formal business settings in major cities; informal social get-togethers are much more relaxed about timing nationwide.

also_check.note: Punctuality is critical; even a few minutes late can be seen as disrespectful.
Arriving 15-30 minutes late is common and often expected in business meetings.
Punctuality is a sign of respect; lateness is generally unacceptable.

sources.title: Turkey — Business Etiquette, Manners, and Culture
